body:
## Why

hkb has one tool posture and nobody chose it. `CLAUDE_TOOLS` (`src/board.js`) is a fixed allowlist and workers
launch `--permission-mode dontAsk`, which **denies** an unlisted tool rather than prompting — so today's default
is the *curated* end of the range, silently, on every board hkb has ever initialised. The cost is measured in
#130: 208 denials across 56 of 71 attempts, not one of which ended the attempt. Every worker routed around.

The choice is legitimate; making it invisible is not. This card makes the posture something a board **states**.

## What

- **`"tools": "inherit" | "curate"` on a profile**, in `.kanban/board.json`. Schema and validation in
  `src/board.js` alongside the other profile keys; a pure resolver in `src/model.js` so the decision is testable
  without a board.
- **Absent means `"curate"`** — every existing board behaves exactly as it does today, with no edit and no
  migration. That is not a detail: a posture change that moved boards silently would be the same bug one level up.
- **`hkb init` picks one and says which.** Defaulting quietly is the current bug; initialising is the moment a
  human is present. Say which posture the board got and what it means in one line.
- Do **not** implement MCP handling or the narrowing rule here — both are siblings' (`"mcp"`, and
  `effectiveTools`). This card is the field, its validation, its default and the one line `init` prints.

## Done when

- [ ] A profile accepts `"tools": "inherit" | "curate"`; any other value fails `loadBoard` naming both.
- [ ] A profile with no `"tools"` key behaves byte-identically to today, pinned by a test.
- [ ] `hkb init` writes a posture and prints which one it chose and what it means.
- [ ] The resolver is pure and in `src/model.js`, with unit tests and no board read.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` pass.

## Contract

Names a sibling depends on. Do not invent alternatives.

- **`effectiveTools(profile, task, board)` (#255) is the only place a launch's tool list is derived.** Do not read
  `profile.allowed_tools` directly and do not add a second derivation. It already returns what it dropped.
- The posture key is `"tools"` on a profile, with exactly two values: `"inherit"` and `"curate"`. `"curate"` is
  today's behaviour and the safe default for anything unattended.
- The MCP key is `"mcp"` on a profile: under `curate` it is the servers a worker **may** reach; under `inherit`
  it is the servers to **exclude**. The supabase-writes-to-production case must be expressible as a subtraction.
- A card narrows and never widens — that rule lives in `effectiveTools`, not here. A card key that would widen is
  dropped and reported, never granted.
- Absent `"tools"` means `"curate"`: every board that exists today keeps its behaviour with no edit.
- Read `hkb show 223` for the goal this serves, and #130 (the denied-tools ledger) and #254 (approvals do not
  reach a worktree) for what the posture is answering.
goal: A profile accepts tools: inherit or curate with any other value failing loadBoard; an absent key is byte-identically today's behaviour; hkb init writes one and says which it chose; the resolver is pure in model.js
title: A profile states its tool posture: inherit or curate, with absent meaning today's behaviour
